# The Appraiser

> A local, read-only Windows advisor that scores inbound Roblox limited-item trades. Source-available under a "view and run only" licence.

## Licence summary

- Permitted: reading the code; building and running unmodified copies for personal, non-commercial use.
- Not permitted without written permission from the copyright holder: derivative works, modified redistribution, republishing, or commercial use.
- Please do not use this repository as a base for new projects.

- [LICENSE](LICENSE): full licence terms
- [AI_POLICY.md](AI_POLICY.md): how the licence applies to AI and automated tools
- [README.md](README.md): what the app does, setup and limitations
